name: sidearm
notes: The gun you are left with: a stubby bullpup with its magazine along the top, accurate enough to be worth aiming and light enough that you go looking for something else. It rewards a head shot by half again. The right button fires bursts of six in rapid succession with a beat between them; the muzzle climbs through a burst, so the first round goes where you aimed and the last ones wander, which makes it a close-range answer. It takes the same bullets as the minigun, out of one store: rounds fired from either are gone from both, and a pad for either fills both.
